visualCharacteristics.purpose: today panel (weekday, large date, month) beside a month date picker for the events agenda
visualCharacteristics.summary: A today panel (day, large date number, month) beside a month datepicker.

contentPattern.structure: one cell: a link to /widgets/activities-calendar.html; query params (agenda, dateparam, lang) become data attributes
rows: Link to /widgets/activities-calendar.html (query params become data attributes)
contentPattern.notes: An interactive JavaScript datepicker tied to the events agenda. No library block fits; the project's widget block loads it from /widgets/.

usage: Agenda date picker. Dates are generated in code; picking a day fires widget-calendar:select and, when agenda is set, navigates to agenda?fecha=yyyy-mm-dd.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever a date picker should drive an events listing. Use the base widget block to load other /widgets/ embeds.
